name: skills
description: Marmik's Claude Code plugins and skills — video generation, mental models, creative generation, product-idea pressure-testing, code-change explainers, codebase understanding, and X growth.

plugins.name: video-gen
plugins.description: 5-stage explainer video pipeline (HyperFrames + Manim + Cartesia/ElevenLabs/fal), with narrative structure, visual style, and narration voice as independent choices.

plugins.name: thinking-models
plugins.description: 40 mental models as invokable skills — first principles, inversion, Bayesian updating, systems thinking, TRIZ, pre-mortem, red team, plus a forming-opinions discipline. Start with thinking-model-router.

plugins.name: creativity
plugins.description: Divergent idea generation — a creative-generation orchestrator (analogical transfer, conceptual blending, abductive gap-finding), constraint-based creativity, and a probability-weighted option sampler.

plugins.name: x-growth
plugins.description: X/Twitter growth via strategic replies — niche profiling, post discovery through twitter-cli, opinion formation, and gated reply drafting.

plugins.name: proven-better-new
plugins.description: Pressure-test a product/startup idea with Mark Pincus's Proven-Better-New framework — isolate the risky novel bet so an idea doesn't die for the wrong reasons before the market sees it.

plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: Turn a diff, branch, or PR into a teaching artifact — background, intuition, a conceptual code walkthrough, and five interactive quiz questions whose options can't be pattern-matched. HTML or Notion output.

plugins.name: understanding
plugins.description: Explain a codebase or a technical idea at whatever depth is asked for — ELI5, a five-level ladder from child to expert, an engineering-audience walkthrough, or a map of an unfamiliar repository.

plugins.name: voice-canvas
plugins.description: A per-session canvas: brainstorm on a webpage, dispatch into the live Claude Code/Codex session you're already in, and check in on what it did. In development.
